candidate_seeds.name: 4D (space+time) displaced-vertex reconstruction with MTD/HGTD
candidate_seeds.framework: Higgs-portal exotic decays / generic neutral LLPs decaying in tracker; precision timing layers
candidate_seeds.idea: Precision timing layers (30 ps) at HL-LHC give a per-vertex arrival delay for LLP decay products, usable as a fourth observable to reject pileup/prompt backgrounds, determine LLP mass/velocity and lifetime. Theory papers show reach but no CMS/ATLAS analysis using MTD/HGTD timing for DVs was found in the INSPIRE queries run.
candidate_seeds.signature_hypothesis: Displaced vertex (or displaced tracks) with tracks arriving late at MTD/HGTD relative to the hard-scatter start time (e.g. defined by VBF tag jets); delayed-DV + MET or h->ss, s->bb.

gap_evidence.quote: While particle identification and kinematic reconstruction are highly developed, usage of timing information has so far been limited since prompt signatures are often assumed.
Dedicated searches at the LHC reconstruct the displaced secondary vertex (SV) produced by the scalar decay from its spatial displacement alone [8, 9].
Long-lived particles that decay inside the tracker are searched for via the spatial displacement of their decay vertices.

candidate_seeds.name: Nested disappearing-track + displaced-vertex cascade (compressed scotogenic)
candidate_seeds.framework: Scotogenic radiative neutrino mass, compressed inert doublet-fermion spectrum
candidate_seeds.idea: In compressed scotogenic spectra the charged scalar leaves a disappearing track and decays to a long-lived neutral fermion that produces a displaced vertex, giving a correlated DT->DV chain; ultra-compressed regime (DeltaM~2 GeV) gives soft displaced leptons with timing delay.
candidate_seeds.signature_hypothesis: Short/disappearing track pointing to a displaced vertex of leptons (+ MET), optionally with MTD timing; soft displaced lepton pairs.

candidate_seeds.name: Emerging photon jets in the hadronic calorimeter
candidate_seeds.framework: Fermiophobic Higgs in Type-I 2HDM; neutral LLP -> gamma gamma (ALP-like)
candidate_seeds.idea: A neutral LLP decaying to photons inside the HCAL yields an EM-like shower with no tracks and no ECAL deposit; the LLP sensitivity extends beyond ECAL-decay (non-pointing photon) analyses to longer lifetimes.
candidate_seeds.signature_hypothesis: Jets with high EM fraction in HCAL, low ECAL energy fraction, zero charged tracks; ALP/h_f -> gamma gamma decays displaced by ~1-2 m.
